title: Helium - Thermophysical Properties
description: Chemical, physical and thermal properties of Helium (He) at 25°C (77°F, 298 K) and atmospheric pressure. Includes molecular weight, density, viscosity, specific heat, thermal conductivity, and other thermodynamic properties in both imperial and metric units.

rows: Density of liquid at atmospheric pressure

components.content:
## Reference Information

**Standard Conditions:** 25°C (77°F, 298 K) and atmospheric pressure

**Property Units:**
- Imperial: ft³/lb, Btu/lb·°F, lbm/ft·s, Btu/hr·ft·°F
- Metric: m³/kg, J/kg·K, cP (centipoise), W/m·°C

**Related Resources:**
- Density and specific weight at varying pressure and temperature
- Atmospheric pressure reference
- STP - Standard Temperature and Pressure
- Comparable thermophysical properties for other gases and liquids

**Safety:** Helium is non-flammable and inert.
